figures.caption: Fig. 1. Overview of the evaluation pipeline. World Color Survey / Munsell chips are rendered as flat patches and shaded spheres, mapped to COLIBRI fuzzy human color memberships, passed through ViT encoders, and evaluated by comparing model representational structure with fuzzy, geometric, and categorical color structure.
Fig. 2. Representative stimuli used in the experiments.

Fig. 4. Natural images from Tiny ImageNet. (a) Balanced probe accuracy for background (◦) and foreground-object (•) color. Segment length shows the object-color selectivity of each encoder. (b) The same effect expressed as ∆ = accfg − accbg, with paired-bootstrap 95% confidence intervals over 7,744 images.
